content.text:
Intel to Keep Working on Elon Musk’s Terafab Chipmaking Venture: The Bloomberg headline says Intel will keep working on Terafab. The retrieved syndicated copy attributes the statement to CEO Lip-Bu Tan, but its revision history is unavailable; only the original feed-captured headline and publication time are verified as pre-cutoff. (time=2026-10-07T04:32:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Intel to Join Musk’s Terafab in Surprise Move, Lifting Stock: Bloomberg reported that Intel joined the Terafab project and described its announced role as helping “refactor” chip-factory technology. The cited passage did not specify production quantities or a binding production order. (time=2026-04-07T13:59:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
